name: beszel-agent
description: Agent for Beszel -- a lightweight server monitoring hub.

paths.name: File System #1
paths.description: The path of the file system you wish to monitor. If you have multiple file systems you wish to monitor, duplicate this path mapping and rename accordingly.

variables.name: Listen Port
variables.description: The port which you have opened for the SSH port.

variables.name: SSH Key
variables.description: Public SSH Key to use for authentication. Provided by the web panel.

variables.name: Root File System
variables.description: Filesystem/partition to use for disk I/O stats. Use 'df -h' to find one.
